integer_types: Indices/counts/length use nonnegative integers checked in U64 range. Reject bool/string/negative/nonintegral values. FIFO phase/sample counts are exact integers, not F32 or elapsed wall time.

clock_formulas.callback_g: 0-based frontend callback; g<2 advances callback owners but emits no codec source and does not execute F07.
clock_formulas.current_body_writer_w: s, 0-based writer generation; JOC body dispatch is s+1.
clock_formulas.published_au_j: s-2 for s>=2; no publication for s0/1
clock_formulas.joc_popped_writer: s-1; empty for s0; source1 writer0 consumed suppressed.
clock_formulas.published_payloads: AU j consumes ID11/1/2 writer j and ID14 writer j+1 (JOC dispatch j+2).

queue_order: All four current bodies ready before mutation; on clones ID11 push/pop, ID1 push/pop, ID2 push/pop, ID14 push/pop. Serialization after gate is11/14/2/1.
suppression: Source0/1 run shared analysis, DRC, numeric plan, JOC/body/timer, all queue push/pop and complete codec scratch frame with ABSENT published metadata. No EMDF parse/build, keyless EMDF checksum, complexity/carrier or published payload validation. Pass ABSENT_PUBLISHED_PAYLOAD_V1; still validate complete codec frame including keyless fixed tail and CRC16. Commit all owners once, no AU append.
cached_parent_calls: Main four cached callbacks reuse last padded input/control snapshot while advancing main state; not four new zero callbacks. Do not borrow independent meter EOF rules.
pending_disposition: At FINALIZING record pending writer identities/hash and DROP_AT_DONE then release storage. No additional pop/push/clock advancement or extra AU. If finalization fails, they remain abandoned-attempt evidence rather than proof of DONE.
independent_meter_scope: Independent F06 meter uses three new-zero drain callbacks; excluded from main cached4/source publication model.
terminal_ledger: Runtime counts derive from the validated programme plan. DONE totals must match that plan; primary example constants/schema do not enforce an exact-primary-N admission rule.

runtime_plan_derived_counts.admission: N and all container/profile/metadata admission must already be validated; checked integer extents throughout
